name: Cultist: Crystalline Reflection reflects damage absorbed by self-cast and ally Void Shields (#10688)
contract: Crystalline Reflection 525060: 'Increases the chance for Void Shield to resist dispel effects on allies by 50%
and it now also reflects 50% of the damage absorbed.' The dispel clause names allies; the reflection clause
applies to every Void Shield 500715, including one the Cultist casts on himself, as solo footage of the talent
shows (#4983). When a Cultist's Void Shield absorbs damage, Crystalline Reflection 525062 strikes the
attacker. A hostile caster's Frostbolt into a self-cast shield and into a shield on a party member must each

steps.label: CONTROL: the Crystalline Reflection passive is active
Void Shield on the Cultist himself
CONTROL: the Cultist carries his own Void Shield
A hostile Frostbolt into the self-cast shield
A second Frostbolt in case the first missed
A self-cast Void Shield reflects absorbed damage to the attacker
Void Shield on the party member
CONTROL: the ally carries the Cultist's Void Shield
A hostile Frostbolt into the ally's shield
A second Frostbolt in case the first missed
A Void Shield on an ally still reflects absorbed damage to the attacker
